verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI capability for live incident summaries, drafted stakeholder or status-page updates, or scribed call notes. The closest features are adjacent: an automated post-mortem generated from the timeline and Slack is retrospective rather than live, and the Slack AI SRE investigates and suggests hypotheses rather than writing the incident record as it unfolds.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing
